spans.s: Ā. (मोचते) To deceive, cheat; see मुञ्च्. --

[[U.]] (मुञ्चति-ते, मुमोच-मुमुचे, अमुचत्-अमुक्त, मोक्ष्यति-ते, मोक्तुम्, मुक्त) 
__1 To loose, set free, release, let go, let loose, liberate, deliver (from captivity &c.); वनाय … यशोधनो धेनुमृषेर्मुमोच [[

]] ‘let not thy limbs droop’, ‘do not despond’. 
__2 To set free, loosen (as the voice); कण्ठं मुञ्चति बर्हिणः समदनः [[

]] ‘loosens his throat or voice’ i. e. raises a cry. 
__3 To leave, abandon, quit, give up, lay aside, relinquish; रात्रिर्गता मतिमतां बर मुञ्च शग्याम् [[
]]; मुनिसुताप्रणयस्मृतिरोधिना मम च मुक्तमिदं तमसा मनः [[Ś. 6. 7]]; मौनं मुञ्चति किं च कैरवकुले [[

.]] 
__4 To set apart, take away, except. See मुक्त्वा. 
__5 To dismiss, send away. 
__6 To cast, throw, hurl, fling, discharge; मृगेषु शरान् मुमुक्षोः [[

.]] 
__7 To emit, drop, pour forth or down, shed, let fall (tears &c.); अपसृतपाण्डुपत्रा मुञ्चन्त्यश्रूणीव लताः [[Ś. 4. 12]]; चिरविरहजं मुञ्चतो बाष्पमुष्णम् [[

.]] 
__9 To give away, grant, bestow. 
__10 To put on (Ā). 
__11 To void (as excrement). 
__12 To sacrifice. -Pass. (मुच्यते) 
__1 To be loosed or released, be freed or absolved from (with abl. or instr.); मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः &c. 
__2 To become loose or relaxed. 
__3 To free oneself, escape. 
__4 To abandon, deviate or swerve from. -Caus. (मोचयति-ते) 
__1 To cause to be freed or liberated. 
__2 To cause to shed. 
__3 To loose, set at liberty, liberate. 
__4 To extricate, disentangle. 
__5 To unyoke, unharness. 
__6 To give away, bestow. 
__7 To gladden, delight. 
__8 To open (a road). 
__9 To redeem from. -Desid. (मुमुक्षति) 
__1 To wish to free or liberate &c. 
__2 (मुमुक्षते, मोक्षते) To long for final emancipation.

a. (At the end of comp.) 
__1 Freeing, liberating, delivering from. 
__2 Discharging, throwing, sending, emitting. 
__3 Giving up, leaving &c.

मुच(चु)कुन्दः
 
__1 N. of a tree (Pterospermum Suberifolium). 
__2 N. of an ancient king, son of Māndhātṛ. [For having assisted the gods in their wars with the demons he got, as a reward, the boon of long and unbroken sleep. The gods also decreed that whosoever dared to interrupt his sleep should be burnt to ashes. When Kṛṣṇa wanted to kill the mighty Kālayavana, he cunningly decoyed him to the cave of Muchakunda, and on his entering it, he was burnt down by the fire which emanated from the king's eye.] 
-Comp. 
-प्रसादकः an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.

a. Liberal, generous. 
-रः 
__1 A deity. 
__2 Virtue. 
__3 Wind, air.
A kind of tree and flower; see मुचकुन्द.

__1 Snapping the fingers. 
__2 A fist. 
__3 A pair of forceps.
